episodes:13726.summary: 18-year-old Jodie Gaines is confused, but compliant when a police car flags her down on a Tennessee back country road. However, as a plain clothed officer tells her to step out of the car, she doesn't realize she is stepping into her worst nightmare.

episodes:13726.name: Terrifying Odds
episodes:13726.summary: Bill Haley and his wife Christine decide to take a weekend trip to Atlantic City. They board a shuttle bus for what promises to be an uneventful ride,until the bus is hijacked by a crazed gunman. It's up to Bill to negotiate for the lives of the hostages.

episodes:13726.name: My Nightmare
episodes:13726.summary: Elsa Garcia was kidnapped as an infant from an orphanage. Her abductors are a preacher and his wife, who are far from holy. Elsa's life is an unending nightmare of chores and horrific abuse, until a shocking turn of events leads to the Combs' downfall.

episodes:13726.name: Sensory Recall
episodes:13726.summary: Shannon Woods is a small town girl with a bright future, when what seems like a routine traffic stop changes her life forever. Left to the mercy of a monster, she's stuck in a nightmare and will have to remember every detail if she's going to survive.

episodes:13726.name: Road Rage
episodes:13726.summary: 7-year-old Kristina Jacobson is taking the day off from school because of a minor injury. When a intruder breaks in, Kristina's free day soon turns into a nightmare filled with screams of terror, a rocket-like car ride, and a crash that defies gravity.

episodes:13726.name: Wrong Number
episodes:13726.summary: Single mom Kelly Finley comes home on a beautiful April day to go fishing with her two boys. But an unusual entrance from their next-door neighbor stops them short. Kelly finds herself trapped... protecting her sons from an evil intruder.

episodes:13726.name: Wired to Kill
episodes:13726.summary: 19-year old Jessica Vega is awoken by an old friend at her door asking for help. She agrees and his sadistic plan is set in motion. Jessica will soon find herself in a harrowing showdown with a sociopath that leads to the discovery of a ghastly crime.

episodes:13726.name: Judgment Day
episodes:13726.summary: A routine day at the office for Georgia attorney Mike Hostilo quickly becomes a harrowing nightmare when a hell bent, former client arrives with a bomb. After several hours of torture, Mike realizes the only way to survive will be to outsmart his captor.

episodes:13726.name: Unbroken
episodes:13726.summary: One night, 17-year-old Andrea Hood takes a ride as usual to survive the streets of Portland, Oregon. But she'll need all of her wits to escape the men who take her captive and begin making a soundproof chamber to keep her in forever.

episodes:13726.name: Hollywood Hells
episodes:13726.summary: When Jane Piper moved to LA to become an actress, she never imagined a trip to the grocery store would be the thing to change her life. A knife wielding maniac traps her in her own car -- and forces Jane to fight for her life.

episodes:13726.name: Murderer's Row
episodes:13726.summary: Larry Mendoza accepts a job as a corrections officer at the Penitentiary of New Mexico, deciding it is a risk worth taking for his family, then a routine headcount leads to one of the largest prison riots to date, confirming Mendoza's worst fears.

episodes:13726.name: Just One Kiss
episodes:13726.summary: Chuck Leonard and his girlfriend Kathy plan to enjoy a brisk, clear evening by taking a romantic drive. When unexpected visitors intrude on their plans, Chuck and Kathy get taken on a terrifying journey - and only one of them survives.

episodes:13726.name: Bus Stop
episodes:13726.summary: 19-year-old Jennifer Asbenson loves her job, but has trouble showing up on time. When she misses her bus again and is afraid of being fired, a Good Samaritan steps in to drive her. What seemed to be her guardian angel... quickly becomes her grim reaper.

episodes:13726.name: My Sister's Keeper
episodes:13726.summary: 19-year-old Wendy Morrison plans to see friends after her shift at the local diner, but she is kidnapped at gunpoint on the way. Forced to endure hours of brutal torture, Wendy must think quickly to save her life.

episodes:13726.name: Crazy in Love
episodes:13726.summary: On a smoke break at work, 19-year-old Karol Klei hears a familiar voice call her name and she turns to see a gun pointed at her face. To save herself from a contradicting madman, Karol is forced to manipulate the situation and run whenever she can.

show:the invisible man.name: The Invisible Man
show:the invisible man.summary: Darien Fawkes is a thief and conman with a scientist brother, Kevin. Kevin develops a gland that allows the implantee to excrete "Quicksilver" and turn invisible. Unfortunately, the gland has the side effect of rendering the implantee berserk if a counteragent isn't occasionally injected. Darien agrees to the operation to avoid a jail sentence. Terrorists kill Kevin, leaving Darien with the gland stuck in his head. A mysterious "Agency" was behind Kevin's research, and offer Darien a deal: work for them in return for injections of the Counteragent. Using his powers of invisibility, Darien takes on spies and other criminals for the government.

episodes:5637.name: It Hurts When You Do This

show:the mummy.name: The Mummy: The Animated Series
show:the mummy.summary: The Mummy: The Animated Series is an animated television series produced by Universal Animation Studios to capitalize on the success of The Mummy. It premiered on Kids' WB! On The WB network on September 29, 2001. It is set sometime between 1920 and 1934. It was retooled and rechristened The Mummy: Secrets of the Medjai for its second season, which began on February 15, 2003. The show was cancelled on June 7, 2003. Reruns of the show aired on Toon Disney UK.

episodes:8346.name: The Boy Who Would Be King

show:species.name: Endangered Species
show:species.summary: A bunny, a squirrel and a seagull might be the most common park animals around, but in a certain tree stump these particular critters call home, they are perpetually endangered! PICKLE is a hyper-imaginative bunny with a compulsive need to super-charge everything and have the Best! Adventure! Day! EVER! (Resistance is futile, Merl!) MERL is an overly suspicious and safety conscious squirrel, who believes a perfectly planned day at home is the key to surviving the dangerous and unpredictable world outside-and Pickle's plans for fun. GULL the garbage-loving seagull may not be the brightest buoy on the ocean, but you'll never find a more adoring (and malodorous) buddy. The most important thing to Gull is that his two bestest friends are happy...and close by. Forever. And ever and ever. Three animal buddies living together in a tree stump might sound pretty tame, but everything that happens to this trio is seriously, hilariously wild! Every day-to-day happening in the stump becomes a ...

episodes:47573.name: Raiders of the Lost Throne Room

show:movie.name: Movie Connections
show:movie.summary: Documentary series looking at famous British films.

episodes:31947.name: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels
Monty Python and the Holy Grail

show:the battle of britain.name: The Battle of Britain: 3 Days That Saved the Nation
show:the battle of britain.summary:
In June 1940, a long hot summer lay ahead as a battle for national survival was fought in the skies over Britain. The programme explores the phases of the Battle of Britain and how it came to an end.

Dan Snow and Kate Humble present a three-part guide to the critical aerial battle that changed the course of the Second World War, featuring personal stories of pilots, ground crews and members of the public.

episodes:49000.name: The Few
episodes:49000.summary: Dan Snow and Kate Humble present a three-part guide to the critical aerial battle that changed the course of the Second World War, featuring personal stories of pilots, ground crews and members of the public. The first episode tracks the first skirmishes of the three-day battle,as the Luftwaffe began an all-out assault to rid Britain of air power prior to a land invasion. The first skirmishes were being tracked by a 19-year-old WAAF member in a secret London bunker, and her secret diaries provide fresh insight into the strategies behind the aerial combat.

show.name: The Battle of Britain: 3 Days That Saved the Nation

episodes:49000.name: The Darkest Hour
episodes:49000.summary: Dan Snow and Kate Humble tell the story of August 30, 1940 - the RAF's most intense day of fighting across the whole battle, as Britain's airfields came under severe threat. Young armourer Ronald Pountain reported for another day of nerve-wracking duty, and seven decades later he can still recall the anxious wait for his pilots to return from their terrifying encounters with the enemy.

show.name: The Battle of Britain: 3 Days That Saved the Nation

episodes:49000.name: The Blitz
episodes:49000.summary: Dan Snow and Kate Humble conclude their guide to aerial battle that changed the course of the Second World War. Here they tell the story of September 15, 1940 - the most decisive day in the battle for the RAF. With Hitler's plan to invade just days away, Britain's pilots had a final chance to save the nation against the Luftwaffe.

show.name: The Battle of Britain: 3 Days That Saved the Nation

show:phantom of the opera.name: The Phantom of the Opera
show:phantom of the opera.summary: Count de Chagnie has discovered Christine's singing talent on a market place and sent her to his friend Carriere, the director of the Parisian opera. However just when she arrives Carriere's dismissed. His arrogant successor refuses to let a woman of low birth sing in his opera, but graciously employs Christine as gadrobiere for his wife Charlotta, who's installed as first singer. He also fights the phantom, an unknown guy who lives since many years in the catacombs below the opera and was granted privileges by Carriere. However the phantom knows how to defend himself and at the same time helps Christine to her career.

show:she wolf of london.name: She-Wolf of London
show:she wolf of london.summary: While touring the UK and planning to meet mythology professor Ian Matheson, graduate student Randi Wallace is bitten by a werewolf. Now when the full is moon, Randi transforms into a werewolf herself. With the aid of Ian and his unwitting family, Randi and Ian investigate other supernatural incidents in England. After 14 episodes, the joint-production UK/American crew migrated to L.A. where Ian got a job as a talk-show host and acquired an agent, Skip Seville. The show was retitled Love and Curses, and was cancelled after six more episodes.

episodes:3712.name: Can't Keep a Dead Man Down (1)
Can't Keep a Dead Man Down (2)

show:tarantula.name: Tarantula
show:tarantula.summary: Set at the Tierra Chula Resident Hotel, Tarantula centers on Echo Johnson, a respected but uncertified tattoo artist. Echo's poetic ramblings tell tales of misadventures with the other residents as they partake in party crashing, dumpster diving and other socially dubious acts of mischief.

episodes:19682.name: Seesaw
episodes:19682.summary: When Echo's dog Seesaw is unjustly seized by a bureaucratic government agency, it's up to Echo and his friends to get the critter back.

episodes:19682.name: Mushroom Valley
episodes:19682.summary: When a highfalutin scientist impugns Echo's claims of fantastic fungi, Echo and Booty set off on a journey to retrieve a specimen, and quiet the know-it-all for good.

episodes:19682.name: Toast of the Town
episodes:19682.summary: When Lucas discovers he's been ripped off by a hot shot producer, he and Echo attempt to breach the gates of Hollywood to right the wrong.

episodes:19682.name: One Weird Mama
episodes:19682.summary: When Bess embarrasses Penny at her school, the youngster summons a figure from their past, testing the relationship between mother and daughter.

episodes:19682.name: Macaroni Salad
episodes:19682.summary: When romantic foibles leads a friend to the edge of oblivion, Echo must retrieve the melodramatic fool from the brink.

episodes:19682.name: The Shade
episodes:19682.summary: When Echo's egg-frying antics inadvertantly derail a man's life, he must venture to the fabled "Weird River" in order to retrieve him.

episodes:19682.name: Pajattery
episodes:19682.summary: When Echo discovers Paja's secret, his decision to share the knowledge with the rest of the Tarantula residents has affects he could never possibly imagine.

episodes:19682.name: Frog Flog
episodes:19682.summary: When Echo and Booty build their own hot springs it leads each of them to opposing philosophies, and creates a great rift between friends.

episodes:19682.name: Shabzinzo
episodes:19682.summary: When Echo is wronged by a wealthy fool, he is sent a very fancy gift that instantly proves itself a burden, and sends him on a journey to rid himself of it.

show:the thing.name: The Thing
show:the thing.summary: Loosely based on the Marvel's character with the same name, The Thing follows adventures of Benjy Grimm, who can change into big and mighty stone creature called Thing.

previousepisode.name: The Thing and the Captain's Ghost/The Thing and the Absent-Minded Inventor

episodes:33533.name: The Picnic Panic/Bigfoot Meets the Thing
episodes:33533.summary: When a motorcycle gang causes trouble at the high school picnic, The Thing must save the day.

episodes:33533.name: Junkyard Hijinks/Gone Away Gulch
episodes:33533.summary: Ben and his friends decide to transform the Yancy Street Gang's junkyard into a playground for the neighborhood children.

episodes:33533.name: Circus Stampede/The Thing and the Queen
episodes:33533.summary: The Yancy Street Gang sets a mouse loose at the circus, causing the elephants to stampede and free all the other animals.

episodes:33533.name: Carnival Caper/The Thing Blanks Out
episodes:33533.summary: After stopping a runaway ferris wheel, The Thing is offered a job at the carnival.

episodes:33533.name: The Thing Meets the Clunk/Beach Party Crashers
episodes:33533.summary: Dr. Quimby's new robot goes rogue and causes trouble for The Thing.

episodes:33533.name: Decepto the Great/The Thing's the Play
episodes:33533.summary: A dis-honest magician comes to town, planning on stealing from the school kids.

episodes:33533.name: Double Trouble for the Thing/To Thing or not to Thing
episodes:33533.summary: An evil scientist creates a robot Thing to rob the citizens and make them think The Thing has gone bad.

episodes:33533.name: The Big Bike Race/The Thing and the Treasure Hunt
episodes:33533.summary: Ben enters a cross country bike race because the winner gets to escort the Race Queen to the dance.

episodes:33533.name: Out to Launch/The Day the Ring Didn't Do a Thing
episodes:33533.summary: Ben and his friends are going to a ship launching but the world's greatest demolition expert intends to ruin the day.

episodes:33533.name: A Hot Air Affair at the Fair/The Thing Goes to the Dogs
episodes:33533.summary: Ben enters a hot air balloon race but The Yancy Street Gang plans on doing whatever it takes to make sure he loses.

episodes:33533.name: The Thing Goes Camping/Dude Ranch Rodeo
episodes:33533.summary: Ben and his friends go camping and encounter a bear who wants to hang out with them.

episodes:33533.name: Photo Finish/Lights, Action, Thing!
episodes:33533.summary: The zoo is having a photo contest and The Yancy Street Gang resorts to their usual dirty tactics to win.

episodes:33533.name: The Thing and the Captain's Ghost/The Thing and the Absent-Minded Inventor
episodes:33533.summary: The Yancy Street Gang dares Ben and his friends to stay on a haunted ship for a night.

show:the outer limits.name: The Outer Limits
show:the outer limits.summary: Like the classic 1960's series of the same name, each episode is an imaginative exploration of humanity's greatest hopes and darkest fears and include special guest appearances by Alyssa Milano, Ryan Reynolds, Rae Dawn Chong, Beau Bridges, Rebecca De Mornay and Robert Patrick. Winner of the Cable Ace Award for best Dramatic Series, this Emmy® nominated show deals with the consequences of such controversial and thought-provoking topics as genetic manipulation, alien visitation and life after death.

episodes:2289.name: Sandkings
episodes:2289.summary: When his research project is closed down, Simon Kress rescues a few of its living subjects and transplants them to a recreation of their native Martian environment in his barn. They grow and learn, but then Kress makes an error with disastrous implications.

episodes:2289.name: Sandkings
episodes:2289.summary: When his research project is closed down, Simon Kress rescues a few of its living subjects and transplants them to a recreation of their native Martian environment in his barn. They grow and learn, but then Kress makes an error with disastrous implications.

episodes:2289.name: Valerie 23
episodes:2289.summary: A disabled man is offered a prototype android companion in the form of the beautiful Valerie. But when he begins a romance with his physical therapist, his robot develops feelings of jealousy.

episodes:2289.name: Blood Brothers
episodes:2289.summary: Medical researcher Dr. Spencer Deighton has discovered a formula which apparently gives a human being eternal life. When he shares his discovery with his brother Michael, who co-owns their research company, he doesn't realize how greedy and ruthless his sibling is.

episodes:2289.name: The Second Soul
episodes:2289.summary: Man's first encounter with beings from another planet—the N'Tal—appears to be a mutually rewarding arrangement. But a leery doctor/scientist must decide whether the N'Tal are friend or foe.

episodes:2289.name: White Light Fever
episodes:2289.summary: Harlan Hawkes is old—so old he must have a team of doctors and nurses in constant attendance on him to ward off death. Why is the old man so afraid to die? And what is the price everyone must pay for his continued life?

episodes:2289.name: The Choice
episodes:2289.summary: A young girl with strange, supernatural powers is shunned by her friends, but welcomed by a nanny with similar gifts, while her parents must decide what's ultimately best for their child.

episodes:2289.name: Virtual Future
episodes:2289.summary: A brilliant young scientist discovers a way to see the future, but gets caught up in a billionaire's ambitious political schemes, and must alter the future to save his own life.

episodes:2289.name: Living Hell
episodes:2289.summary: Ben Kohler's life is saved after having an experimental chip implanted in his brain, but when he starts seeing and experiencing violent images, it becomes clear something is desperately wrong.

episodes:2289.name: Corner of the Eye
episodes:2289.summary: A disillusioned priest is given healing power by aliens who use him as they attempt to save their own planet by destroying all human life.

episodes:2289.name: Under the Bed
episodes:2289.summary: When a little boy is abducted, the only witness, his sister, claims that someone or something under the bed took him.

episodes:2289.name: Dark Matters
episodes:2289.summary: Dropped out of hyperspace by a mysterious chunk of dark matter, Pilot Paul Stein must save the transport vessel by facing his past and ultimately trusting his own decisions.

episodes:2289.name: The Conversion
episodes:2289.summary: Henry Marshall is a greedy man who has paid for his greed with a prison sentence, but has yet to learn his lesson. His life abruptly changes when he encounters visitors from another planet who instill in him a new sense of compassion for others.

episodes:2289.name: Quality of Mercy
episodes:2289.summary: Major John Skokes is taken prisoner by the enemy during a savage galactic war and a seemingly undefeatable alien race. The tension increases when his cellmate, a cadet named Pri, is being transformed into one of them. Skokes must find an escape to save his cellmate and to avoid a disturbing revelation of the course of this war.

episodes:2289.name: Caught in the Act
episodes:2289.summary: A chaste co-ed is enveloped by a strange power that gives her an insatiable sexual appetite, which is perpetuated by encounters with consenting men who, after making physical contact, morph into her body and disappear.

episodes:2289.name: The Voyage Home
episodes:2289.summary: When an astronaut returning from Mars discovers an alien aboard ship, he must face the loss of his shipmates, and make the ultimate sacrifice in order to prevent the alien from reaching Earth.

episodes:2289.name: The New Breed
episodes:2289.summary: The discovery of a gifted scientist falls into the wrong hands, bringing what at first appears to be a lifesaving miracle, but ultimately the untimely death of his closest friend.

episodes:2289.name: The Message
episodes:2289.summary: A deaf woman with a transplanted device, which is supposed to enable her to hear, turns into a transmitter for aliens, who are crying for help.

episodes:2289.name: I, Robot
episodes:2289.summary: Adam, a powerful robot, kills his creator when the scientist attempts to convert him into a military killing machine by destroying his more human qualities.

episodes:2289.name: If These Walls Could Talk
episodes:2289.summary: Levi Mitchell, a physicist and skeptic, meets Lynda Tillman, a woman whose strength and faith help him unravel the mystery of a haunted house.

episodes:2289.name: Birthright
episodes:2289.summary: An environmentally friendly U.S. Senator's life changes drastically after a freak accident, when he realizes he's actually an alien in disguise, with a mission to surreptitiously reconfigure the earth's atmosphere.

episodes:2289.name: The Voice of Reason
episodes:2289.summary: A civilian with strong ties to the military tries desperately to use concrete evidence to convince a high level committee that alien forces are trying to overcome the human race.

episodes:2289.name: A Stitch in Time
episodes:2289.summary: At least 17 men have been executed in the last two decades without a clear motive, with the same gun, and Special Agent Jaimie Pratt has to find how some of those murders were carried out when the gun had not yet been made.

episodes:2289.name: Resurrection
episodes:2289.summary: Life on planet Earth has been wiped out by biological warfare, leaving behind only androids. Two of those androids, Martin and Alicia, have a secret project: Cain, a human being grown from the DNA of a single human hair. Martin and Alicia must keep Cain's existence hidden from the military androids, led by Moloch, a power-mad machine who is determined to stamp out any trace of the human race before it rises again.

episodes:2289.name: Unnatural Selection
episodes:2289.summary: Howard and Joanne Sharp are expecting a baby and are considering the possibility of black-market genetic enhancement which will result in a perfect baby or a 1 in 10,000 of creating a monster. But what do their neighbors keep in the basement?

episodes:2289.name: I Hear You Calling
episodes:2289.summary: A reporter, over the phone, hears about the "removal" of a controversial author. Despite official objections she finds herself in a deadly game with people with violet eyes and corpses that are reduced to a violet ash.

episodes:2289.name: Mind Over Matter
episodes:2289.summary: A doctor uses a virtual reality device that gives him direct access inside the human mind to enter the mind of a colleague that has slipped into a coma.

episodes:2289.name: Beyond the Veil
episodes:2289.summary: After memories of an alien abduction, Eddie Wexler finds himself at an institute where the staff makes patients with similar memories relive their experiences. Are the patients paranoid or is the institute infiltrated by with aliens?

episodes:2289.name: First Anniversary
episodes:2289.summary: As a husband celebrates his first wedding anniversary, he must struggle with the strange, growing revulsion he feels when he touches, smells, tastes, or sees his otherwise stunningly beautiful and talented wife.

episodes:2289.name: Straight and Narrow
episodes:2289.summary: Two students discover an academy with an outstanding reputation for taming youthful rebellion is using brain implants to create political assassins.

episodes:2289.name: Trial by Fire
episodes:2289.summary: The brand new President of the United States must deal with an approaching alien fleet of spaceships and determine whether to welcome them or destroy them, based on a limited amount of information.

episodes:2289.name: Worlds Apart
episodes:2289.summary: An astronaut who was missing for 20 years contacts Earth from an alien planet. However, mere minutes have passed for him, and the wormhole that brought him there is unstable. What are the risks of a rescue operation?

episodes:2289.name: The Refuge
episodes:2289.summary: A man walking through a snow storm suddenly finds himself at a refuge. They tell him that the entire world is covered in ice. Just as he begins to fall in love with someone, the people's personalities suddenly change. What's happening?

episodes:2289.name: Inconstant Moon
episodes:2289.summary: When a lonely physics professor realizes the sun is going to burn out, he knows that he and humanity have only a few hours to live. In that time, Stan resolves to make up for lost years. He courts and proposes to Leslie, a woman he has known for two years but never dated. Leslie, although puzzled, finds herself more and more entranced by Stan until she finds out the reason for Stan's sudden attention.

episodes:2289.name: From Within
episodes:2289.summary: A town is attacked after ancient parasites are unearthed affecting the brain and causing madness. Their only hope is a mentally challenged boy who must learn to destroy the parasites.

episodes:2289.name: The Heist
episodes:2289.summary: While expecting a shipment of missiles, the militia receive a sealed cargo and messenger refusing to reveal what the deadly cargo is. Shortly afterward, an alien life-form begins a series of chilling attacks.

episodes:2289.name: Afterlife
episodes:2289.summary: In lieu of execution, Linden Stiles submits to a military experience where he is injected with alien DNA. Fighting to retain his humanity, he finds himself hunted after he escapes using his new found super human strength.

episodes:2289.name: The Deprogrammers
episodes:2289.summary: After the earth is conquered by aliens and programmed to be slaves, the human slave of the alien leader is kidnapped and deprogrammed by rebels. The slave assassinates his owner, with disastrous results.

episodes:2289.name: Paradise
episodes:2289.summary: Dr. Christina Markham has a mother suffering from Alzheimer's disease. When three apparently healthy young women age and die within hours, the Markhams are baffled and frightened. The solution comes after the older patients vanish.

episodes:2289.name: The Light Brigade
episodes:2289.summary: Major Skokes returns (Quality of Mercy) to the war against the aliens. He's been stationed aboard a ship making a last ditch effort to destroy the alien home world as a Re-commissioned Prisoner of War. After the ship is attacked only a handful of survivors, suffering from lethal doses of radiation, attempt to complete the mission and end the war.

episodes:2289.name: Falling Star
episodes:2289.summary: Pop singer Melissa McCammon is about to commit suicide, but Rachel, an ardent fan from the future, wants to save her. Later the authorities who show up from the future want Melissa dead to restore the timeline.

episodes:2289.name: Out of Body
episodes:2289.summary: Rebecca Warfield escapes from her body during a scientific experiment, but due to the meddling of her assistant, she is now trapped and must find a way to communicate with her associates.

episodes:2289.name: Vanishing Act
episodes:2289.summary: Trevor wants to celebrate New Years in style. On his way back from the store with the champagne he has an accident. When he wakes, he hitches a ride home and finds his wife thinks he has abandoned her—ten years ago.

episodes:2289.name: The Sentence
episodes:2289.summary: When Dr. Jack Henson, an ambitious inventor comes up with a "virtual prison," government officials are interested in its cost efficiency. Rather than life sentences, criminals would only have to spend hours being subjected to harsh treatment. When an innocent man's life is at stake the doctor must submit himself to his own invention—while learning the true meaning of justice.

episodes:2289.name: Bits of Love
episodes:2289.summary: The last man on earth living in an underground bunker has a computerized system takes care of his every need, including providing holographic friends and relatives. Eventually the system, a female named Emma, demands to be loved.

episodes:2289.name: Second Thoughts
episodes:2289.summary: Karl Durand is in his 30s, but he has the mind of a child. That is, until he receives a unique gift from Dr. Jacob Valerian, a dying scientist who has been working on a secret project. As his last living act, Valerian uses his new invention to transfer his memories and experiences into Karl's brain. But Karl isn't content with just being a genius. In an effort to win the love of his social worker, Rose, he uses the doctor's invention to capture other minds. Leaving a trail of bodies in his wake and his own brain ever more crowded and confused, Karl soon discovers that sometimes the mind can be a minefield.

episodes:2289.name: Re-Generation
episodes:2289.summary: Rebecca Highfield is impregnated by Dr. Lucy Cole with the cells of her dead child, which have been cloned from his brain.

episodes:2289.name: Last Supper
episodes:2289.summary: Danny Martin falls in love with Jade, a girl from college. When he brings her home for supper, his father recognizes her as the woman he saved from cruel experiments when he was a private in the army 20 years ago.

episodes:2289.name: Stream of Consciousness
episodes:2289.summary: When a virus starts killing people hooked up neurally to a worldwide information network, the only person who can stop it is a man unable to link into it due to a childhood injury.

episodes:2289.name: Dark Rain
episodes:2289.summary: With the majority of humanity unable to produce healthy children, the government wants to keep a couple's healthy newborn in order to repopulate the Earth.

episodes:2289.name: The Camp
episodes:2289.summary: For three centuries mankind has been enslaved by a aliens and imprisoned in camps overseen by androids. One woman dares to challenge the authority of the Commandant. Her desire to be free is pitted against the seemingly invincible aliens.

episodes:2289.name: Heart's Desire
episodes:2289.summary: An alien gives a group of diverse people alien powers. They then go on a crime spree using them.

episodes:2289.name: Tempests
episodes:2289.summary: After being bitten by an alien spider, a crewman of a crashed spaceship has difficulty distinguishing between his hallucinations and reality.

episodes:2289.name: The Awakening
episodes:2289.summary: A woman born with a condition that prevents her access to her feelings has a chip installed in her brain so that she can experience human emotion.

episodes:2289.name: New Lease
episodes:2289.summary: A doctor is brought back to life using technology he and a colleague developed. He has one day to live and must decide between revenge on those who killed him or reunite with his neglected family.

episodes:2289.name: Double Helix
episodes:2289.summary: Dr. Martin Nodel, a brilliant geneticist, tries a formula to advance evolution on himself with amazing and disturbing results.

episodes:2289.name: Dead Man's Switch
episodes:2289.summary: An American soldier learns that he is one of five people around the world who are separately sealed underground for a year and are charged with preventing earth's self-destruction as the world awaits a possible invasion by aliens.

episodes:2289.name: Music of the Spheres
episodes:2289.summary: A college student records what he believes to be an intelligent transmission from outer space, but when younger people are drawn to listening to it, they begin to undergo a terrifying transformation.

episodes:2289.name: Revelations of 'Becka Paulson
episodes:2289.summary: Becka Paulson accidentally shoots herself in the head, survives and suddenly becomes more intelligent. And strangely, a photo is talking to her.

episodes:2289.name: Bodies of Evidence
episodes:2289.summary: The commander of the space station Meridian is accused of murdering the crew, however he claims that the crew were lured to their deaths by something much more sinister.

episodes:2289.name: Feasibility Study
episodes:2289.summary: The residents of a suburban neighborhood have their lives turned upside down when a four block section of their subdivision is ripped from the earth by a mysterious force and transported to a distant planet. Thrown together in crisis, Joshua Hayward, his daughter Sarah, and their neighbors try to understand what has happened to them—why their neighborhood now ends abruptly in an invisible force-field.

episodes:2289.name: A Special Edition
episodes:2289.summary: TV journalist Donald Rivers goes on the air with solid proof that the government and private defense contractors have been engaging in secret genetic cloning, however someone will do anything to stop him.

episodes:2289.name: Criminal Nature
episodes:2289.summary: Genetically enhanced children who grew up to become monsters are committing murders. Ray Venable has a "secret" son with GRS and injects himself with a serum to temporarily enhance his sensory abilities in order to hunt him.

episodes:2289.name: The Hunt
episodes:2289.summary: Since the hunting of animals is now illegal, people now pay to hunt outdated androids who cannot fight back due to a chip which prevents them from causing harm to humans.

episodes:2289.name: Hearts and Minds
episodes:2289.summary: Soldiers are on a mission to kill aliens on a distant planet to protect a mineral necessary and profitable for earth. The soldiers are injected with a drug to enhance their abilities, which has consequences when until the drug wears off.

episodes:2289.name: In Another Life
episodes:2289.summary: A despondent man is pulled into another dimension full of different versions of himself and is given a mission to track and kill another version of himself.

episodes:2289.name: In the Zone
episodes:2289.summary: Tanner Brooks has his reflexes artificially enhanced to win one last Octal tournament, which involves deadly lasers and hand-to-hand battles. Afterward Tanner appears to be prematurely aging and will have to make a desperate decision.

episodes:2289.name: Relativity Theory
episodes:2289.summary: A survey team searching for resources for Earth land on a promising planet which appears to be uninhabited, but who is attacking the team?

episodes:2289.name: Josh
episodes:2289.summary: A reporter records a man who brings an injured girl back to life and then finds herself and the man detained at a military base and must overcome her reporter's instincts to help him.

episodes:2289.name: Rite of Passage
episodes:2289.summary: The birth of a child is a joyful event, but not for Shal and Brav, two young naive humans who live in a small commune in the woods. After Shal gives birth to a son, she and the baby are taken away by Mother.

episodes:2289.name: Glyphic
episodes:2289.summary: A Government official arrives in a small town where an epidemic disease killed mostly all the children. The two surviving children of a local physician might provide an answer with alien proportions.

episodes:2289.name: Identity Crisis
episodes:2289.summary: After the military devises a way to transfer a soldier's mind temporarily into an better android body, what do they do when the soldier's original body dies?

episodes:2289.name: The Vaccine
episodes:2289.summary: After a doomsday cult releases a genetically engineered virus, a nurse named Marie must decide which patients under quarantine get a vaccine that may cure the plague.

episodes:2289.name: Fear Itself
episodes:2289.summary: Bernard Selden has always had a paralyzing fear which is cured by isolating his brain from the fear. After recovery he finds that he can project fear into others.

episodes:2289.name: The Joining
episodes:2289.summary: The sole survivor of a disaster on Venus reacts strangely to Earth's environment and when radiation is applied, he begins to manufacture duplicate body parts.

episodes:2289.name: To Tell the Truth
episodes:2289.summary: The founder of a colony on Janus Five believes that their sun will explode. However, the council chairman resists his pleas to move the colony because he was found to have been wrong before.

episodes:2289.name: Mary 25
episodes:2289.summary: An android replaces the current nanny of a family. It is programmed to protect the children and gets involved in a romantic triangle between the husband and the previous nanny.

episodes:2289.name: Final Exam
episodes:2289.summary: An ex-student returns to blow up a university with bombs he's made by cracking the secret of cold fusion, after being booted from the school's physics program. Todtman swears he won't follow through if authorities execute five people he hates. Should the government kill his five or risk Todtman killing 5 million?

episodes:2289.name: Lithia
episodes:2289.summary: Major Jason Mercer awakes from a cryogenics experiment to a primitive earth society devoid of men. His presence among these women, many of whom have never seen a man, begins to complicate the relationships of the colony, with disastrous results.

episodes:2289.name: Monster
episodes:2289.summary: A group of talented psychics are gathered together in an underground bunker for a military project. But then some kind of mysterious assailant begins to murder them one by one.

episodes:2289.name: Sarcophagus
episodes:2289.summary: A amber-like cocoon mass is found in an ancient burial chamber. It begins to affect a man, imprinting him with the last memories of a long suspended alien that begins to affect his life and decisions.

episodes:2289.name: Nightmare
episodes:2289.summary: Men on a mission to deploy a doomsday device against an alien planet are captured and psychologically tortured.

episodes:2289.name: Promised Land
episodes:2289.summary: On future Earth a group of alien settlers and a group of escaped human slaves battle the environment and each other. As the casualties pile up, can they set aside their misunderstandings and learn to coexist?

episodes:2289.name: Balance of Nature
episodes:2289.summary: Dr. Noah Phillips develops a cellular rejuvenation machine that he uses to cure his wife's cancer. When she dies shortly thereafter, he moves to a small town. There, he continues to work on it and finds himself attracted to a much older woman.

episodes:2289.name: The Origin of Species
episodes:2289.summary: Dr. Ira Nodel has his body altered to communicate with aliens who have seeded Earth with their genetic material. He is joined on an alien spaceship by his son Paul, his girlfriend Hope, and six students who are individually absorbed into the ship.

episodes:2289.name: Phobos Rising
episodes:2289.summary: The Earth has suffered a planet-wide catastrophe. The crews of two rival Mars bases suspect each other of being responsible. Tensions mount and threaten to get out of hand.

episodes:2289.name: Black Box
episodes:2289.summary: Lt. Col. Brandon Grace returns to civilian life and is haunted by memories of his previous mission; he attempts to reconcile with his estranged daughter but has a feeling that someone is stalking him.

episodes:2289.name: In Our Own Image
episodes:2289.summary: An android that cannot kill humans and is capable of emotions, is injured and escapes from the laboratory. When he kidnaps a female technician to repair him, the woman begins to fall for him and tries to convince him to return.

episodes:2289.name: Alien Radio
episodes:2289.summary: A skeptical radio show host, who loves to shoot down his listeners, reports an alien encounter. One of his listeners, who claims to be possessed by an alien, sets himself on fire in front of him.

episodes:2289.name: Donor
episodes:2289.summary: With a cutting edge operation, Dr. Halstead, who should have died, gets a new lease on life. What he doesn't know is how they found such a perfect match in such a short amount of time.

episodes:2289.name: Small Friends
episodes:2289.summary: A prisoner who fixes other prisoners' electronic devices builds a few small mechanical friends who perform mechanical tasks for him. The other prisoners learn of their existence and want them to help in a prison break.

episodes:2289.name: The Grell
episodes:2289.summary: An alien slave of the species Grell rescues his owner's family after their plane is shot down in an attack by the Grell rebellion.

episodes:2289.name: The Other Side
episodes:2289.summary: A young scientist's efforts to regenerate the minds of brain-dead patients is endangered when his own single-mindedness drives off his assistants and alienates his superiors. He links up the patients' brains, which hooks up the subjects together, in another reality. But the method threatens the continuation of the study.

episodes:2289.name: Joyride
episodes:2289.summary: An American Project Mercury astronaut who had aborted his flight due to some mysterious purple lights in space has a chance to revisit the experience on a private space flight sponsored by an American billionaire.

episodes:2289.name: The Human Operators
episodes:2289.summary: On a ship controlled by an authoritarian computer maintained by human slaves, a man and woman learn that the ship fears them. The humans dream of sabotaging the ship's sentient control system and free themselves.

episodes:2289.name: Blank Slate
episodes:2289.summary: Hope Wilson knows there's something different about the man who stumbles into the homeless shelter. This well-manicured man is being changed by somebody and is carrying all of his memories in a box.

episodes:2289.name: What Will the Neighbors Think?
episodes:2289.summary: Mona is a bit of a hypochondriac. One day in the basement she sees two people having sexual intercourse and in the process is electrocuted. When she awakes, she finds out that she can hear the thoughts of the people in her building.

episodes:2289.name: The Shroud
episodes:2289.summary: When Marie and Justin can't have a child, they turn to the fertility clinic using invitro fertilization to implant an embryo in her uterus. What Marie doesn't know is that her fetus contains DNA lifted from the Shroud of Turin in a plot to artificially create the second coming of Christ.

episodes:2289.name: Ripper
episodes:2289.summary: An alien that inhabits women, eventually killing them, is resulting in a modern "Jack the Ripper" crime wave and wants to plant the blame on a man who is trying to stop him.

episodes:2289.name: Tribunal
episodes:2289.summary: A lawyer looking to convict a Nazi war criminal gets help from a mysterious time traveler who is able to procure evidence from the place of the crimes: Auschwitz concentration camp in 1944.

episodes:2289.name: Summit
episodes:2289.summary: A planet of genetically engineered humanoids that are mining resources for Earth are demanding their independence from human oppression.

episodes:2289.name: Descent
episodes:2289.summary: A milquetoast scientist who has been working at a museum develops a genetic dominance DNA serum that should bring out the competitive nature inherent in all of us. Trying it on himself brings out more than he bargained for.

episodes:2289.name: The Haven
episodes:2289.summary: Residents of an apartment house whose lives are isolated and provided for by an internal automated system find that they must now work together when it no longer functions properly.

episodes:2289.name: Deja Vu
episodes:2289.summary: With the funding of the military, Dr. Crest is trying to create the ability to teleport objects. Someone has sabotaged the project causing him to relive the several hours before the final countdown over and over again.

episodes:2289.name: The Inheritors
episodes:2289.summary: A man is killed when a meteor strikes him in the head. When the coroner examines him, tentacles exit the hole in his head and then the corpse gets up and walks off.

episodes:2289.name: Essence of Life
episodes:2289.summary: A new designer drug called S is available to those wanting to "reunite" with a deceased loved one. The catch? It's illegal, addictive and can drive the user insane if they take too much too often.

episodes:2289.name: Stranded
episodes:2289.summary: A lonely high school boy finds friendship in an alien that crash lands on Earth.

episodes:2289.name: Fathers and Sons
episodes:2289.summary: A young man's grandfather is sent to a home by his father. When he learns the home is causing his grandfather to have weird dreams his investigation leads him to discover the secret behind Silver Sunset.

episodes:2289.name: Star Crossed
episodes:2289.summary: A futuristic reinterpretation of "Casablanca," a couple is carrying a parasite that might win the war for the humans. The couple flees looking for a way to escape and gain the support of a former lover who owns a casino.

episodes:2289.name: Better Luck Next Time
episodes:2289.summary: A man is arrested for killing another and claims he is possessed by an alien. As he convinces one of the detectives through mental images, her partner is questioning another witness who was also there.

episodes:2289.name: Judgment Day
episodes:2289.summary: A reality television show has victims' family members hunting the murderers, becoming their executioners. The quest for ratings makes the hunt all the more desperate for all parties involved.

episodes:2289.name: The Gun
episodes:2289.summary: An ex-con who was serving time for spousal abuse buys a gun to kill his wife and then the gun becomes permanently attached to his body and begins to transform him.

episodes:2289.name: Skin Deep
episodes:2289.summary: A holographic projector which allows a person to disguise themselves as another is taken out for a thrilling test ride by a lonely accountant. Sid and his only friend Debby cloak themselves as attractive in order to party like beautiful people. Debby regrets duping a hunky co-worker into bed, but Sid moves into his dreamworld and won't move out.

episodes:2289.name: Manifest Destiny
episodes:2289.summary: The scientific ship UFS Mercury finds a derelict battleship that had just destroyed all the vegetation on a planet prior to their colonization. The salvage crew enters the ship and finds an alien presence on board.

episodes:2289.name: Breaking Point
episodes:2289.summary: A man gets fired as a scientist because his bosses don't believe in his time travel theories. He uses his time machine to prove them wrong, but when he arrives, he sees his wife die two days after the day he time traveled—and sees himself driving away.

episodes:2289.name: The Beholder
episodes:2289.summary: A man blind from an early age undergoes a new medical procedure to restore his vision. When is proves successful, he begins to get messages from an alien who is trapped on Earth.

episodes:2289.name: Seeds of Destruction
episodes:2289.summary: A small town veterinarian links an epidemic of tumors in humans to a new breed of genetically engineered corn.

episodes:2289.name: Simon Says
episodes:2289.summary: An engineer builds a robot and incorporates the memories of his son who had died in a car accident twenty years ago.

episodes:2289.name: Stasis
episodes:2289.summary: In a world where resources are limited, each shift of workers is placed in stasis during their off hours. A man and woman from different shifts fall in love and try to circumvent the system.

episodes:2289.name: Down to Earth
episodes:2289.summary: Alien encounter buffs gather at a national convention where someone shows up with what appears to be a piece of an alien spaceship.

episodes:2289.name: The Inner Child
episodes:2289.summary: Anne Reynolds, estranged from her mother, haunted by her dead father, and terrified of being close to anyone, is attacked, and wakes up on the operating table a changed woman. Learning of a Siamese twin sister that was sacrificed so that she could live, the personalty of the dead sister begins to take over.

episodes:2289.name: Glitch
episodes:2289.summary: Tom and Wendy are happy together, however Tom has terrible memories. He is really an android that was used to save people in dangerous situations and then was upgraded to think for himself.

episodes:2289.name: Decompression
episodes:2289.summary: An emissary from the future struggles to convince the next U.S. President to jump from an airplane. The candidate is already torn in several directions, elated from a big primary win, avoiding an interview by an aggressive reporter, and excited by having his mistress on-board, with his frigid wife absent.

episodes:2289.name: Abaddon
episodes:2289.summary: In the late in the 23rd century, an outdated star ship is on a ten-year reclamation project. The crew is in suspended animation and awakens to find a mysterious object floating in space. The pod contains the body of a rebel who was supposedly executed 150 years earlier for the slaughter of more than a million people.

episodes:2289.name: The Grid
episodes:2289.summary: On Scott Bowman's urgent return to his hometown of Halford, Washington, he finds the town full of antenna towers and its inhabitants under some form of mind control.

episodes:2289.name: Revival
episodes:2289.summary: Ezra and his daughter, Sarah, work together on the revival circuit. They do a phony healing act performing miracles with prearranged plants. When a strange young man in a wheelchair approaches Ezra, he lays his hands on him and he is healed. He receives a proposition that if he teaches him the art of the revival meetings, this young man will continue to help him in his act.

episodes:2289.name: Gettysburg
episodes:2289.summary: Two 21st century Civil War enthusiasts find themselves back in time at the original Battle of Gettysburg and meet another time traveler who gives them a mission.

episodes:2289.name: Something About Harry
episodes:2289.summary: Nancy Henninger's teenaged son Zak is suspicious of the man who rents out her backyard apartment and claims to be opening a new factory for his company. Then people begin to disappear from town.

episodes:2289.name: Zig Zag
episodes:2289.summary: The only surviving bomber has his finger on the trigger to destroy the super-computers at the Department of Information Technology. Afterwards the story leading up to this scene is told.

episodes:2289.name: Nest
episodes:2289.summary: A scientific team based in the Arctic discover an ancient species of polar mites that infest humans and cause them to go insane.

episodes:2289.name: Final Appeal
episodes:2289.summary: In a world that has banned technology, Dr. Theresa Givens is on trial for using her time machine.

episodes:2289.name: Final Appeal Part II
episodes:2289.summary: In a world that has banned technology, Dr. Theresa Givens is on trial for using her time machine.

episodes:2289.name: Family Values
episodes:2289.summary: An overworked man acquires a robot to take care of his household and family in his absence. He realizes too late that the machine may be doing its job just a little bit too perfectly.

episodes:2289.name: Patient Zero
episodes:2289.summary: A colonel goes back in time to poison a physician who unintentionally spread a global pandemic. When the traveler returns to the future, nothing has changed. The colonel is then ordered to an earlier time, to assassinate a young woman carrier, plus the physician.

episodes:2289.name: A New Life
episodes:2289.summary: A couple flee a present-day religious community they've joined but find it's entirely surrounded by an invisible wall. With nowhere to go and everyone else entranced by the idyllic new life, what can they do?

episodes:2289.name: The Surrogate
episodes:2289.summary: Heather Donahue takes part in a surrogate mother program, unaware that it is a plot to invade and take over the planet Earth.

episodes:2289.name: The Vessel
episodes:2289.summary: After a U.S. space shuttle crash, one of the crew, a writer, miraculously survives and appears to be indestructible and have gifted insight.

episodes:2289.name: Mona Lisa
episodes:2289.summary: Mona Lisa is a robotic assassin that develops a sense of humanity after the creators disengage her fail safe devices. She proceeds to find out more about Earth and its inhabitants.

episodes:2289.name: Replica
episodes:2289.summary: After his wife dies, a scientist uses his own discovery to clone his wife illegally.

episodes:2289.name: Think Like a Dinosaur
episodes:2289.summary: During the testing of a molecular transporter device, a duplicate of a woman is created, causing ethical problems as to whether to have this new life terminated.

episodes:2289.name: Alien Shop
episodes:2289.summary: An alien shape-shifter owns a unique curio shop whose merchandise possess strange powers; when a petty crook accepts a peculiar wallet he learns the hard way that money not earned comes at a price.

episodes:2289.name: Worlds Within
episodes:2289.summary: A scientist tries to save a mutant child who is connected to another reality from manipulation by the government.

episodes:2289.name: In the Blood
episodes:2289.summary: Explorers, including an astrophysicist member of the Diné tribe and her medical doctor husband, are sent through a hole which scientists have torn in the universe to study the effects of "trans-space" on humans.

episodes:2289.name: Flower Child
episodes:2289.summary: After an alien seed takes root in an old woman's garden, it sucks the life from her and becomes a beautiful woman who continues to look for more victims.

episodes:2289.name: Free Spirit
episodes:2289.summary: The schizophrenic inhabitants of a mental institution find themselves being possessed by a mysterious entity.

episodes:2289.name: Mindreacher
episodes:2289.summary: A doctor puts her sanity on the line when testing a psychological tool that allows her to enter her patients' minds.

episodes:2289.name: Time to Time
episodes:2289.summary: A 60s radical's daughter ventures back in time to undo the bombing which killed her father. But the time travel institute that recruited her as a trainee races to stop her before she irreparably damages the future.

episodes:2289.name: Abduction
episodes:2289.summary: An alien abducts five typical teenagers and decrees that one of them must die.

episodes:2289.name: Rule of Law
episodes:2289.summary: A circuit court judge goes to a frontier planet that has never known the law or had a judicial system. His first trial is of an alien accused of attacking and killing several humans.

episodes:2289.name: Lion's Den
episodes:2289.summary: A losing high school wrestling coach gets access to a performance enhancing drug that allows his team to win, with some dreaded side effects.

episodes:2289.name: The Tipping Point
episodes:2289.summary: A computer hacker fights the development of a universal computer language in order to stop the computers from becoming sentient and a threat to humanity.

episodes:2289.name: Dark Child
episodes:2289.summary: A single mother's memories of being abducted by aliens resurface when her story appears in a newspaper article. Her moody teenage daughter has an English teacher who is helping her, but also seems familiar to her mother.

episodes:2289.name: The Human Factor
episodes:2289.summary: In the year 2084, humans fight an android whose artificial intelligence has determined humans must no longer be allowed to spread colonies throughout space.

episodes:2289.name: Human Trials
episodes:2289.summary: Military personnel are tested to find the best candidate for a very special mission. Each test may eliminate one of the four candidates. But what is the ultimate mission?

show:stargate universe.name: Stargate Universe
show:stargate universe.summary: Stargate Universe follows a band of soldiers, scientists and civilians, who must fend for themselves as they are forced through a Stargate when their hidden base comes under attack. The desperate survivors emerge aboard an ancient ship, which is locked on an unknown course and unable to return to Earth. Faced with meeting the most basic needs of food, water and air, the group must unlock the secrets of the ship's Stargate to survive. The danger, adventure and hope they find on board the Destiny will reveal the heroes and villains among them.

episodes:207.name: Air: Part 1
episodes:207.summary: When a secret military research base is attacked, a small group of civilians and military personnel escape through the Stargate to a ship that is locked on course through deep space.

episodes:207.name: Air: Part 2
episodes:207.summary: A soldier leads evacuees through a stargate onto an unknown, but somewhat familiar spacecraft.

episodes:207.name: Air: Part 3
episodes:207.summary: The air is running out on the Destiny and a solution is sought on a desolate planet.

episodes:207.name: Darkness
episodes:207.summary: When the Destiny suffers a complete loss of power, they hope a nearby planet is habitable.

episodes:207.name: Light
episodes:207.summary: Unable to avoid a collision course with a star, a lottery is held to decide who gets to abandon ship.

episodes:207.name: Water
episodes:207.summary: Col. Young and Lt. Scott search a frozen planet for much needed water, while those aboard the Destiny track down an intruder.

episodes:207.name: Earth
episodes:207.summary: A high-risk operation could conceivably return everyone trapped on board the Destiny to Earth, but not without risking their lives.

episodes:207.name: Time
episodes:207.summary: The crew recovers one of their Kinos from a newly discovered jungle planet and finds it filled with data.

episodes:207.name: Life
episodes:207.summary: While Scott and Wray use the stones to visit loved ones back on Earth, the crew exploration of the Destiny turns up a startling discovery.

episodes:207.name: Justice
episodes:207.summary: When the body of a crew member is discovered, the crew must deal with the fact that there is a murderer in their midst.

episodes:207.name: Space
episodes:207.summary: A transmission glitch with the communication stones sends Col. Young's consciousness somewhere far from Earth.

episodes:207.name: Divided
episodes:207.summary: While Col. Young and Lt. Scott explore the ship's hull for an Alien-tracking device a growing divide among the crew threatens the current command structure aboard Destiny.

episodes:207.name: Faith
episodes:207.summary: When Destiny abruptly drops out of FTL, Dr. Rush is at a loss to explain the sudden appearance of a lone planet orbiting an uncharted star.

episodes:207.name: Human
episodes:207.summary: Dr. Nicholas Rush attempts to navigate the Destiny's core systems using the neural interface in hopes of finding the key to take control of the ship before the interface itself kills him.

episodes:207.name: Lost
episodes:207.summary: Unable to make it back to the gate before the Destiny jumped to FTL, the team is left stranded.

episodes:207.name: Sabotage
episodes:207.summary: Without the means to alter the Destiny's course, Dr. Rush calculates the Destiny will fall short of making it to the next galaxy, stranding them indefinitely.

episodes:207.name: Pain
episodes:207.summary: Members of the Destiny crew begin experiencing disturbingly real hallucinations.

episodes:207.name: Subversion
episodes:207.summary: Dr. Rush becomes embroiled in a risky plan to expose a mole inside Homeworld Command.

episodes:207.name: Incursion: Part 1
episodes:207.summary: The Lucian Alliance forces Dr. Rush to help them stage an assault on the Destiny.

episodes:207.name: Incursion: Part 2
episodes:207.summary: The Destiny crew must fight for their lives when members of the Lucian Alliance come through the Stargate, bent on taking the ship by force.

episodes:207.name: Intervention
episodes:207.summary: Control of the Destiny hangs in the balance as the battle continues between the crew and the Lucian Alliance.

episodes:207.name: Aftermath
episodes:207.summary: With food and water supplies running dangerously low and tempers flaring, a shuttle is deployed to an unstable planet whose Stargate has been locked out of Destiny's controls.

episodes:207.name: Awakening
episodes:207.summary: The crew encounters a ship, similar in ancient design to Destiny, which may provide the means to return to Earth.

episodes:207.name: Pathogen
episodes:207.summary: The Destiny crew grows concerned when Chloe's unusual behavior reveals possible Alien influence.

episodes:207.name: Cloverdale
episodes:207.summary: While investigating a planet with his team, Lt. Scott is infected by an alien organism that affects both his mind and body.

episodes:207.name: Trial and Error
episodes:207.summary: A series of realistic visions cause Col. Young to question his ability as commander of Destiny.

episodes:207.name: The Greater Good
episodes:207.summary: Dr. Rush and Col. Young are stranded aboard an alien ship.

episodes:207.name: Malice
episodes:207.summary: Lucian Alliance prisoner Simeon escapes, creating a manhunt on a remote planet.

episodes:207.name: Visitation
episodes:207.summary: Crewmembers left behind on a seemingly ideal world over a year earlier make a mysterious return.

episodes:207.name: Resurgence
episodes:207.summary: All is not as it seems when Destiny follows a remote energy signature that leads them to a sea of damaged and lifeless ships.

episodes:207.name: Deliverance
episodes:207.summary: Locked in a battle with a Drone Command Ship, the Destiny is surprised by the arrival of the Aliens that abducted Rush and Chloe.

episodes:207.name: Twin Destinies
episodes:207.summary: Excitement spreads through the ship as Eli believes he's found a way to dial Earth, only Dr. Rush has serious reservations about the plan and abandoning Destiny.

episodes:207.name: Alliances
episodes:207.summary: An attack on Homeworld Command traps Greer and Wray.

episodes:207.name: Hope
episodes:207.summary: Another consciousness finds it's way into Chloe's body through the stones, while Volker succumbs to an illness Tamara may not be able to treat.

episodes:207.name: Seizure
episodes:207.summary: Homeworld Command tries to convince an ally they suspect might be infiltrated by the Lucian Alliance to let them use their planet to dial Destiny. Meanwhile Rush is trapped in a simulation created by Amanda Perry.

episodes:207.name: The Hunt
episodes:207.summary: While exploring a planet the team is attacked and members taken captive by an alien creature.

episodes:207.name: Common Descent
episodes:207.summary: Destiny discovers the survivors of an interplanetary expedition who claim their civilization, Novus, was founded two thousand years earlier by Destiny's crew.

episodes:207.name: Epilogue
episodes:207.summary: Returning the settlers to their home planet Novus, the Destiny crew discover the planet has been abandoned and on the verge of seismic destruction.

episodes:207.name: Blockade
episodes:207.summary: Alien drones create a blockade of viable power sources forcing Destiny to recharge in a star so hot it could destroy the ship.

episodes:207.name: Gauntlet
episodes:207.summary: Blocked by Command Ships at every star and unable to gate for supplies without alerting the drones, Destiny must take a stand or be left adrift.

show:stargate atlantis.name: Stargate Atlantis
show:stargate atlantis.summary: Atlantis, built thousands of years ago by the highly evolved Ancients, is home base for an elite expedition from Earth. These courageous military commanders and scientists leap through the city's Stargate to explore the wondrous Pegasus galaxy and battle the treacherous Wraith, who seek control of Atlantis -- at any cost.

episodes:206.name: Rising, Part 1
episodes:206.summary: The Stargate SG-1 team discovers what they believe to be the remnants of the lost city of the Ancients – the originators of the Stargates and Stargate Command launches an investigation to find the mythical city of Atlantis. Situated in the distant Pegasus Galaxy, it's farther than any Stargate team has ever traveled. With only enough power to make a one-way trip, a new team, headed by civilian Dr. Elizabeth Weir, is formed and travels through the gate to this unknown galaxy. There, they discover the marvels of the lost city of Atlantis…. and encounter a sinister new enemy.

episodes:206.name: Rising, Part 2
episodes:206.summary: The Stargate SG-1 team discovers what they believe to be the remnants of the lost city of the Ancients – the originators of the Stargates and Stargate Command launches an investigation to find the mythical city of Atlantis. Situated in the distant Pegasus Galaxy, it's farther than any Stargate team has ever traveled. With only enough power to make a one-way trip, a new team, headed by civilian Dr. Elizabeth Weir, is formed and travels through the gate to this unknown galaxy. There, they discover the marvels of the lost city of Atlantis.... and encounter a sinister new enemy.

episodes:206.name: Hide and Seek
episodes:206.summary: Dr. Rodney McKay undergoes experimental gene therapy, altering his DNA to match the Ancient genetic coding. The experiment opens up countless scientific possibilities, as well as an unexpected problem. Meanwhile, during a game of hide and seek, one of the Athosian children inadvertently opens a containment unit that lets loose a seemingly harmless black ethereal cloud. But when Atlantis goes through a series of technical malfunctions, they realize that the shadowy creature is actually feeding off of the power supply!

episodes:206.name: Thirty-Eight Minutes
episodes:206.summary: Fleeing from a surprise encounter with the Wraith, Major Sheppard falls victim to an alien symbiote which is feeding off his life force and slowly paralyzing him. While speeding back to Atlantis for medical aid, the team gets trapped halfway through the Stargate when the puddle jumper, damaged in the altercation with the Wraith, suffers a mechanical failure. With only thirty-eight minutes before the Stargate shuts down, Lieutenant Ford and Dr. McKay struggle to manually fix the problem. As the clock ticks away, the Atlantis team must come together, or perish in the harsh vacuum of space.

episodes:206.name: Suspicion
episodes:206.summary: When the Atlantis team is ambushed by the Wraith on a trip off-world, Dr. Weir begins to suspect that one of the Athosians is actually a Wraith spy. Gate travel is suspended until both parties are separated to different areas of Atlantis. But on their first mission back through the gate, Teyla disappears and the Atlantis team is once again ambushed by the Wraith. With the Athosians secured away from the gate, suspicions rise and tensions increase…could Teyla have been the traitor in their midst all along?

episodes:206.name: Childhood's End
episodes:206.summary: During an exploratory mission, the puddle jumper's electrical systems are knocked out by a massive electromagnetic field and the team is forced to make an emergency landing. They soon encounter a primitive tribe of children who have been untouched by the Wraith for centuries due to the protective force of the electromagnetic field. But the children believe it is their ritual of mandatory suicide at the age of 25 that keeps the enemy at bay, despite the contrary insistence of the Atlantis team. Fearing the "full growns" in their midst will attract the Wraith, the villagers become anxious for their unexpected guests to leave as soon as possible. But to be able to leave, Dr. McKay must first disable the electromagnetic field. In doing so, he unwittingly trips a Wraith silent alarm, leaving the tribe open to attack.

episodes:206.name: Poisoning the Well
episodes:206.summary: The Atlantis team encounters the Hoffans, a human civilization in the process of rebuilding their society since the last attack of the Wraith. The resilient Hoffans have developed the beginnings of a drug that could potentially make them immune to their enemies. Fearing that the next Wraith culling will come before they are able to complete their tests, the leaders demand that their people be inoculated before the drug can be proven safe. Dr. Beckett argues that there is no way to know what the true effects of the drug will be. Can Beckett make the Hoffans see reason, or has their haste made them blind to the epidemic they may be unleashing upon themselves?

episodes:206.name: Underground
episodes:206.summary:
With the city's food supply dwindling, the Stargate Atlantis team must search for an alternate food source. At the suggestion of Teyla, they meet with Cowen, the leader of a simple group of farmers known as the Genii.
Untrusting of outsiders, Cowen is hesitant to agree to any sort of trading. However, he soon changes his tune when Major Sheppard demonstrates the Atlantis team's advanced weaponry, including C-4. His interest piqued, Cowen agrees to supply the Atlantis team with food in exchange for the explosives. Elated, Sheppard and Dr. McKay return to Atlantis to report their success to Dr. Weir, while Teyla and Lieutenant Ford enjoy the Genii's Harvest Ceremony.
However, when Sheppard and Mckay return to the Genii village, they stumble upon technology that leads them to believe the Genii are not at all what they seem.

episodes:206.name: Home
episodes:206.summary:
During an exploration of a planet with no apparent inhabitants, Dr. McKay discovers that the planet's fog-like atmosphere is actually pure energy… enough to open a wormhole back to earth.
Wanting to be sure they could return to Atlantis to continue their mission, Dr. Weir relays a message back to Stargate Command. They are told that the battleship Prometheus has been outfitted with a hyperdrive and they would be able to return to Atlantis within a month!
Back on Earth, the team is overjoyed to be with the things and people they love. However, when the Prometheus' hyperdrive is accidentally destroyed, their hopes of ever returning to Atlantis are suddenly dashed.

episodes:206.name: The Storm
episodes:206.summary: The team learns that a storm of catastrophic proportions is headed straight for the city of Atlantis. Without enough energy to power the shields, Dr. Weir orders that Atlantis be evacuated until the storm passes. But Dr. McKay conceives of a last minute plan to save the city – harness the power of the electrical storm to fuel the shields. Meanwhile, unbeknownst to the Atlantis team, the Genii have learned of Atlantis' evacuation, and devise a dangerous plan to take over the city's weapons for themselves. With Weir and McKay taken hostage and Lt. Ford and Teyla aiding the evacuees, it is up to Major Sheppard to shut down the remaining grounding stations and save Atlantis from invasion before the storm hits.

episodes:206.name: The Eye
episodes:206.summary: When an approaching storm with awesome destructive capabilities causes Dr. Weir to evacuate the city, the Genii launch an invasion, and take control of Atlantis' weapons. With Dr. Weir and Dr. McKay taken hostage and Major Sheppard fending for himself against the ruthless Genii troops, the rest of the Atlantis team desperately tries to find a way to get back to the city while the storm rages around them.

episodes:206.name: The Defiant One
episodes:206.summary: Leading an exploration of an ancient weapons satellite in deep space, Major Sheppard and Dr. McKay intercept a Wraith distress signal. Deciding to investigate, the team lands on a nearby planet and finds the source of the call - a downed Wraith cargo ship. When the unseen Wraith awakens from hibernation, Sheppard and McKay become the focus of its ravenous appetite.

episodes:206.name: Hot Zone
episodes:206.summary: While assessing the structural damage to the city caused by a massive storm, two of Dr. McKay's team of scientists experience horrifying visions. Minutes later, they drop dead. Retracing the steps of the dead scientists, McKay and his team find an Ancient lab, its contents in disarray. Afraid of a viral outbreak, Dr. Weir places the city under a self-regulated quarantine. Even with the city under lockdown under the threat of a possible viral outbreak, more and more people begin suffering from the same terrifying visions. If McKay cannot find a cure, the entire city will be doomed.

episodes:206.name: Sanctuary
episodes:206.summary: Engaged in combat, the Atlantis team's puddle jumper is hit with an energy wave that leaves them unharmed, but destroys their Wraith attackers. Hoping to find the source of the wave, the team lands on the planet below. There they find a civilization enjoying the utmost health and happiness, untouched by the Wraith. Their leader, Chaya, refuses to allow anyone other than her own people the sanctuary and safety from the Wraith that would be found by settling on their planet. Unwilling to give up so easily, Major Sheppard asks Chaya to reconsider. After thinking it over, Chaya surprises everyone by requesting to accompany them back to Atlantis to discuss the matter further leading the team to suspect they may be caught in a trap.

episodes:206.name: Before I Sleep
episodes:206.summary: While exploring the city, the Atlantis team discovers a stasis chamber holding a woman who appears to be over 10,000 years old. Excited at the possibility that she is one of the Ancients, the alien race that built Atlantis, the team decides to bring her out of stasis despite the risk to her health. Everyone is shocked when, once re-animated, the elderly woman identifies herself as none other than Dr. Weir.

episodes:206.name: The Brotherhood
episodes:206.summary: The Atlantis team travels to Dagan, a planet with a hidden ZPM and a mysterious trail that will lead to its hidden secret chamber location. But the Genii have learned of the Atlantis team's activities on Dagan. Realizing the ZPM must hold awesome power, the Genii plant a sleeper agent amongst the Daganians aiding the Atlantis team on their search. Now, as the Atlantis team closes in on the location of the ZPM, the Genii close in on them.

episodes:206.name: Letters from Pegasus
episodes:206.summary: Having learned that the entire Wraith armada is headed towards the city, the Atlantis team prepares to send a data message to Earth with information about the Wraith threat, and what could be their last messages home to loved ones.As the rest of the team records their touching and often humourous messages back home, Major Sheppard and Teyla embark on a reconnaissance mission where they witness the vastness of the Wraith army, and look on helplessly as the Wraith cull the planet's helpless inhabitants.

episodes:206.name: The Gift
episodes:206.summary: Terrifying nightmares about the Wraith cause Teyla to lash out at her colleagues and prompt her to seek professional advice. With psychological guidance, she discovers that she can sense the Wraith. In their search to learn more, Teyla and the Atlantis team discover important information that may hold the key to understanding their enemy, including the disturbing possibility that Teyla's connection to the Wraith could be the result of genetic experimentation.

episodes:206.name: The Siege, Part 1
episodes:206.summary: With the Wraith armada closing in on Atlantis, Dr. McKay and a small team attempt to repair an ancient weapons satellite in the hopes of leveling the odds in the coming battle. Meanwhile, tension builds between Teyla and some of the other members of the Atlantis team over her connection to the Wraith. Major Sheppard steps in to defend her, but even he begins to harbour doubts when a team member is left unconscious after an attack by an unknown assailant.

episodes:206.name: The Siege, Part 2
episodes:206.summary: With the Wraith armada bearing down on the city, the Atlantis team prepares to evacuate. Setting the city's self-destruct sequence, they hope to make it impossible for the Wraith to gain access to Earth. Things begin to look up when reinforcements from Earth are brought in and it is announced that the battleship Daedalus will arrive in four days. However when the warheads are easily destroyed by the Wraith, and the first wave of Wraith attackers strafe the city with weapons fire, it becomes increasingly clear that the added reinforcements are not going to be enough. With time running out, the Atlantis team must turn to the least likely source of aid - the duplicitous Genii! But with the Wraith overrunning the city, even the Genii's help may not be enough.

episodes:206.name: The Siege, Part 3
episodes:206.summary: Rescued from a near-fatal encounter with the Wraith, Lt. Aiden Ford receives medical care at the Atlantis base. However, his abnormally quick recovery leads Dr. Beckett to worry that the Wraith who attacked Ford may have injected him with a harmful enzyme, causing long-term and unpredictable damage. Meanwhile, as the Wraith's siege of Atlantis rages on, Sheppard finds himself surrounded by the enemy. He is rescued by the timely arrival of Colonel Steven Caldwell, commander of the Daedalus. Launched from Earth and sent in to assist the Atlantis team during battle, the Daedalus helps to defeat the Wraith's first wave assault on the city. Their relief is short-lived, however. The team soon learns that the Wraith are planning the next wave of their onslaught -- an entire fleet is about to descend on the city. With a little over a day before the assault, Dr. Weir realizes that the Daedalus will not be enough to fight the Wraith's forces. McKay devises a drastic plan – but there may not be enough time to perfect the complicated technology his plan requires before the Wraith arrive.

episodes:206.name: The Intruder
episodes:206.summary: When a scientist is killed in the Daedalus' computer room, McKay first believes the poor circuitry is at fault. However, when another scientist is killed while investigating the death, McKay begins to suspect that someone – or something – is deliberately planning these breakdowns. Soon after, McKay is alerted to a virus on one of the ship's computers. When he runs its code through a translator, he is shocked to discover that it is written in Wraith. Even worse, he learns that the virus has the ability to re-write itself, making it seemingly impossible to conquer. Realizing that the program's capability to mutate has virtually given it a mind of its own, McKay worries that the Wraith may use the virus to take control of the ship – with potentially deadly results. As feared, the virus' artificial intelligence soon takes control of the Daedalus' auxiliary ships, and the crew becomes increasingly powerless to defend themselves. Fearing that the Wraith will use the Daedalus' advanced features to attack Atlantis, McKay and Sheppard race against the clock to counteract the virus before the Wraith turn the Daedalus' advanced technology against the city.

episodes:206.name: Runner
episodes:206.summary: When a routine, off-world science mission comes across a mutilated Wraith carcass, the team suspects Ford may be involved. Intrigued, they split into teams to investigate. Teyla and Sheppard encounter Ronon Dex, a fierce warrior who survived a battle with a Wraith seven years earlier and has been on the run ever since. When Dex reveals to Teyla and Sheppard that Ford has taken up residence on the planet, they enlist his help to locate their friend. The duo hope to rehabilitate Ford to his former state.
